title: AgentOS Store Tool Definition
description: Schema for tool definitions in the AgentOS store (tools/*.json). Validated on install and at startup by the app.

anyOf.description: HTTP tool: defines a declarative endpoint surface
Prompt-only tool: instructions given to the LLM

id.description: Unique tool id, lowercase alphanumeric with _ and -

prompt.description: Instructions given to the LLM about how to use this tool

parameters.description: JSON Schema string describing the LLM-facing action parameters

endpoints.description: Map of endpoint name to endpoint definition; the actual HTTP surface of the tool

actionMap.description: Optional aliases mapping LLM-chosen action names to endpoint names

headers.description: HTTP headers sent on every request

paramDefaults.description: Legacy default values; prefer endpoint query/path defaults

url.description: Full URL. Use {param} placeholders for path params declared under 'path'.

path.description: Path parameters; each {key} in url must have a matching entry here

paramBinding.description: Binds a URL parameter to an LLM parameter, a static value, or a default

from.description: Name of the LLM action parameter to read

default.description: Fallback when the 'from' parameter is absent

required.description: Request fails fast if the 'from' parameter is absent

fields.description: Dot-paths of response fields to include in the tool output, e.g. "markets.0.price"

maxChars.description: Truncation limit for this endpoint's output

recordSep.description: For text responses only: delimiter that starts each record (e.g. "<entry" for Atom feeds). Truncation then happens at whole-record boundaries and appends "[Truncated: showing N of M records]" so the model knows results were cut.
